022import java.time.DateTimeException;
023import java.time.ZoneId;
024import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
025import java.time.format.DateTimeParseException;
026import java.time.temporal.TemporalAccessor;
027import java.util.Locale;
028
029import org.apache.commons.lang3.StringUtils;
030import org.apache.logging.log4j.LogManager;
031import org.apache.logging.log4j.Logger;
032import org.apache.turbine.Turbine;
033import org.apache.turbine.annotation.TurbineService;
034import org.apache.turbine.services.TurbineBaseService;
035import org.apache.turbine.util.LocaleUtils;
036
037/**
038 * This service is used to format {@link TemporalAccessor} and
039 * {@link #map(String, DateTimeFormatter, Locale)} (different flavors)
040 * objects into strings.
041 * <p> 
042 * The methods may throw {@link java.time.temporal.UnsupportedTemporalTypeException} or
043 * {@link DateTimeParseException}, e.g.
044 * if the source and the target format do not match appropriately.
045 * </p>
046 *
047 */
048@TurbineService("DateTimeFormatterService")
049public class DateTimeFormatterService
050        extends TurbineBaseService implements DateTimeFormatterInterface 
051{
052
053    private String formatPattern = null;
054
055    private DateTimeFormatter dateTimeFormat = null;
056
057    private Locale locale = null;
058
059    private ZoneId zoneId;
060
061    @Override
062    public DateTimeFormatter getDefaultFormat()
063    {
064        return dateTimeFormat;
065    }
066
067    @Override
068    public String getFormatPattern() {
069        return formatPattern;
070    }
071
072    private static final Logger log = LogManager.getLogger(DateTimeFormatterService.class);
073
074    /**
075     * Initialize the service.
076     * <p> <p> <p> <p>
077     * the {@link #dateTimeFormat} from {@link #formatPattern} is initialized with
078     * 
079     * <ol>
080     * <li>{@link Locale}: {@link LocaleUtils#getDefaultLocale()} is used by default.
081     * It could be overridden setting #USE_TURBINE_LOCALE_KEY to false, the
082     * the default Locale {@link Locale#getDefault()} is used.
083     * </li><li>{@link ZoneId}: If #DATE_TIME_ZONEID_KEY is set this {@link ZoneId} 
084     * is used else {@link ZoneId#systemDefault()}.
085     * </li>
086     * </ol>
087     */
088    @Override
089    public void init()
090    {
091        formatPattern = Turbine.getConfiguration()
092                .getString(DATE_TIME_FORMAT_KEY, DATE_TIME_FORMAT_DEFAULT);
093
094        boolean useTurbineLocale =  Turbine.getConfiguration()
095        .getBoolean(USE_TURBINE_LOCALE_KEY, true);
096
097        Locale localeSetter = (useTurbineLocale && LocaleUtils.getDefaultLocale() != null)?
098                LocaleUtils.getDefaultLocale()
099                : Locale.getDefault();
100        setLocale(localeSetter);
101
102        String zoneIdStr = Turbine.getConfiguration()
103        .getString(DATE_TIME_ZONEID_KEY);
104        ZoneId zoneIdSet = (zoneIdStr != null)?  ZoneId.of( zoneIdStr ) :
105            ZoneId.systemDefault();
106         setZoneId(zoneIdSet);
107
108        dateTimeFormat = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(formatPattern)
109                .withLocale(localeSetter).withZone(zoneIdSet);
110
111        log.info("Initialized DateTimeFormatterService with pattern {}, locale {} and zone {}",
112                formatPattern, dateTimeFormat.getLocale(),
113                dateTimeFormat.getZone());
114        setInit(true);
115    }
116
117    @Override
118    public <T extends TemporalAccessor> String format(T temporalAccessor)
119    {
120        return dateTimeFormat.format(temporalAccessor);
121    }
122
123    @Override
124    public <T extends TemporalAccessor> String format(T temporalAccessor, String dateFormatString)
125    {
126        return format(temporalAccessor, dateFormatString, null, null);
127    }
128
129    @Override
130    public <T extends TemporalAccessor> String format(T temporalAccessor, String dateFormatString, Locale locale)
131    {
132        return format(temporalAccessor, dateFormatString, locale, null);
133    }
134
135    @Override
136    public <T extends TemporalAccessor> String format(T temporalAccessor, String dateFormatString, Locale locale,
137            ZoneId zoneId) {
138        String result = null;
139
140        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(dateFormatString) || temporalAccessor == null)
141        {
142            result = "";
143        }
144        else
145        {
146            DateTimeFormatter dtf =
147                    DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(dateFormatString);
148            if (locale != null)
149            {
150                dtf = dtf.withLocale(locale);
151            } else {
152                log.warn("adding default locale {}",  getLocale() );
153                dtf = dtf.withLocale( getLocale());
154            }
155            if (zoneId != null)
156            {
157                dtf = dtf.withZone(zoneId);
158            } else {
159                log.info("adding default zone {}", getZoneId() );
160                dtf = dtf.withZone(getZoneId());
161            }
162            log.info("try to format {} with {}.", temporalAccessor, dtf );
163            try {
164                result =
165                        dtf.format(temporalAccessor);
166            } catch(DateTimeException e) {
167                log.error("An exception with date time formatting was thrown: {}", e);
168                // check with dtf.toFormat().format(temporalAccessor)?
169                throw e;
170            }
171        }
172        return result;
173    }
174
175    @Override
176    public String map(String src, String outgoingFormatPattern, Locale locale, String incomingFormatPattern)
177    {
178        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(src) || outgoingFormatPattern == null)
179        {
180            return "";
181        }
182        if (incomingFormatPattern == null)
183        {
184            incomingFormatPattern = formatPattern;
185        }
186        if (incomingFormatPattern.equals( outgoingFormatPattern )) {
187            return "";
188        }
189        DateTimeFormatter incomingFormat = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(incomingFormatPattern);
190        DateTimeFormatter outgoingFormat = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(outgoingFormatPattern);
191        if (locale != null)
192        {
193            outgoingFormat = outgoingFormat.withLocale( locale );
194            //incomingFormat = incomingFormat.withLocale( locale );
195        }
196        return map( src, outgoingFormat, locale, incomingFormat );
197    }
198
199    @Override
200    public String map(String src, DateTimeFormatter outgoingFormat, Locale locale,
201                      DateTimeFormatter incomingFormat)
202    {
203        if (StringUtils.isEmpty(src) || outgoingFormat == null)
204        {
205            return "";
206        }
207        if (incomingFormat == null)
208        {
209            incomingFormat = dateTimeFormat;
210        }
211        if (incomingFormat.equals( outgoingFormat )) {
212            return "";
213        }
214        if (locale != null)
215        {
216            outgoingFormat = outgoingFormat.withLocale( locale );
217            //incomingFormat = incomingFormat.withLocale( locale );
218        }
219        return  outgoingFormat.format(
220                incomingFormat.parse( src ));
221    }
222
223    @Override
224    public String mapTo(String src, DateTimeFormatter outgoingFormat)
225    {
226        return map( src, outgoingFormat, null, dateTimeFormat );
227    }
228
229    @Override
230    public String mapFrom(String src, DateTimeFormatter incomingFormat)
231    {
232        return map( src, dateTimeFormat, null, incomingFormat );
233    }
234
235    @Override
236    public String map(String src, DateTimeFormatter outgoingFormat, Locale locale)
237    {
238        return map( src, outgoingFormat, locale, dateTimeFormat );
239    }
240
241    public Locale getLocale() {
242        return locale;
243    }
244
245    public void setLocale(Locale locale) {
246        this.locale = locale;
247    }
248    
249    @Override
250    public ZoneId getZoneId() {
251        return zoneId;
252    }
253
254    public void setZoneId(ZoneId zoneId) {
255        this.zoneId = zoneId;
256    }
257
258}
